facts.text: I am thinking of trying a new coffee bean from Ethiopia.
I am a beginner coffee drinker looking for a good Ethiopian coffee bean to start with.
I think I will start with the Kochere Ethiopian coffee bean.
I want to know if the Kochere is available in a medium roast.
I want brewing method recommendations to bring out the best flavors of the medium-roasted Kochere.
I am thinking of trying a new coffee-to-water ratio for my pour-over.
I am thinking of adding cardamom to my coffee.
I have heard that cardamom pairs well with Ethiopian coffee.
I want the best way to add cardamom to my pour-over.
